source_findings.html_trim_note: upstream trims the whole input string before parsing (html.trim()), so leading/trailing whitespace of the whole document is not preserved by upstream either; whitespace inside a blockquote is not affected by this trim

technical_conclusion: The converter unconditionally constructs a jsdom 30.0.1 DOM and accepts no DOM injection, so jsdom cannot be avoided without substituting a different DOM (forbidden as upstream evidence). The only single-request transfer (esm.sh dependency-inlined bundle) exceeds the 1 MiB FETCH cap; FETCH supports no byte ranges. Per-tarball reassembly requires jsdom plus roughly 30 transitive packages plus lexical/@lexical/* and @tryghost deps, far beyond the 12-request limit. Upstream execution is not achievable with current tools.
